definition: Week for two = lodging for 7 nights (the Airbnb total for two before tax, as shown on the listing on the date given) + lodging or tourist tax at the rate shown + two adult 6-day lift passes at the local price, converted at the rates above. Food and travel are left out of every row. The US$3,000 budget is tested against lodging plus tax, because a season pass (Epic or Ikon) already covers the lifts at several of these resorts; lift prices are shown in their own column so the total can be compared either way. The September version of the Engelberg figure also counted about $750 to $1,150 of food, so it is not comparable with these.
